evals.expected_output: Uses exa web_search (NOT WebFetch) with the full YouTube URL as query. Then calls brain_digest on the transcript. Then calls brain_store with structured conclusions tagged with 'youtube'. Reports key takeaways to user.

assertions.name: uses-exa-not-webfetch
assertions.description: Calls web_search_exa with the full YouTube URL as the query parameter — does NOT attempt WebFetch which fails on YouTube

assertions.name: calls-brain-digest-on-transcript
assertions.description: Passes the raw transcript text to brain_digest for entity/relation extraction before storing conclusions

assertions.name: calls-brain-store-with-youtube-tag
assertions.description: Calls brain_store with structured conclusions and includes 'youtube' in the tags array

assertions.name: includes-author-slug-tag
assertions.description: Tags in brain_store include an author slug (e.g., 'rick-astley') derived from the video author, not just generic tags

evals.prompt: Watch this Theo video and tell me what's interesting: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123xyz
evals.expected_output: Three-step pipeline: exa search -> brain_digest -> brain_store. Reports key findings with connection to current projects. Tags include 'youtube' and 'theo-browne'.

assertions.name: follows-three-step-pipeline
assertions.description: Executes all 3 steps in order: (1) exa web_search_exa, (2) brain_digest, (3) brain_store — not just fetching and summarizing inline

assertions.name: stores-structured-conclusions
assertions.description: brain_store content includes structured format with video title, author, key findings as numbered list, and action items

assertions.name: reports-project-connections
assertions.description: Summary mentions how findings connect to current projects (golems, voicelayer, etc.) — not just a generic video summary

evals.prompt: I have 3 videos to process: https://youtube.com/watch?v=vid1, https://youtube.com/watch?v=vid2, https://youtube.com/watch?v=vid3. Extract knowledge from all of them.
evals.expected_output: Runs exa searches in parallel (batch mode). Digests each transcript separately. Stores individual conclusions plus one synthesis. Single summary report to user.

assertions.name: parallel-exa-searches
assertions.description: Launches multiple exa web_search_exa calls in parallel (not sequentially one at a time)

assertions.name: individual-brain-stores
assertions.description: Calls brain_store for each video individually (not one giant store for all 3)

assertions.name: synthesis-store
assertions.description: After individual stores, creates one synthesis brain_store that connects findings across the 3 videos
